stories.title: Create Aesthetic C01 Performance Assessment with Bilingual Client Consultation Evaluation Rubric
stories.description: Develop a Performance Assessment document for Aesthetic C01 (Client Consultation) with detailed evaluation rubrics in English and Malay, enabling assessors to evaluate learner competency in professional client interaction, needs analysis, and treatment planning.
acceptanceCriteria: Create PA.md file with evaluation rubrics for minimum 4 key competencies (professional communication, listening, needs analysis, treatment recommendation) with 5-point scale
Include bilingual rubric descriptors (EN/BM) for each competency level with consistent terminology across all rubrics
Provide sample assessment scenario with completed rubric example demonstrating how to score learner performance
technicalNotes: Validation: grep -c "BM:" aesthetic-services/C01-client-consultation/PA.md (should be >= 20 for bilingual consistency)
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 0 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Create IT-020-3 System Security Knowledge Points and Assessment for C01
stories.description: Develop Knowledge Point documents for IT-020 Level 3, Competency Unit C01 (System Security Fundamentals), covering authentication, access control, and encryption, with corresponding Assignment Sheet and Knowledge Assessment aligned with NOSS CoCU.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 3 KP files (KP-01: User Authentication, KP-02: Access Control, KP-03: Encryption Basics) with technical depth and practical examples from industry standards
Create KT assignment sheet (KT-01) with 4 questions testing knowledge from all 3 KPs with answer schemes
Create KA knowledge assessment with minimum 8 questions covering system security fundamentals with marking rubric and answer schemes
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/C01-system-security/KP-01.md, KP-02.md, KP-03.md, KT-01.md, KA.md
